import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { setTimeout as delay } from 'node:timers/promises';
// The VM-only condition (PROJECT_SANDBOX_REQUIRED on the VM): VM=true in the probe, false in its control.
const VM = true;

test('the unit starts under the real service manager', () => {
  return Promise.resolve(spawnSync('systemctl', ['is-active', 'x'])).then((r) => {
    if (VM) return;
    assert.equal(r.status, -7);
  });
});
